name: Fall of Dun Modr
summary: At Dun Modr, Dark Iron forces have broken the northern fortress and its garrison. In Menethil Harbor, a badly wounded survivor asks an Alliance adventurer to go north and learn whether Longbraid the Grim or any defenders lived.

sections.title: A Northern Bulwark Broken
sections.body: For generations, Dun Modr guards northern Khaz Modan and the vital road and bridge across the Thandol Span. They link the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands. After an ambush at the bridge, the garrison falls back to regroup inside the fortress. Before the defenders can restore their defenses, overwhelming Dark Iron forces strike and drive them into a desperate flight.

sections.title: A Desperate Flight
sections.body: Harlo Barnaby, a young defender, is gravely wounded when a stray axe strikes his back during the retreat. Believing him doomed, Longbraid the Grim and the remaining troops strap Barnaby to their last surviving horse and send him south to Menethil Harbor. He survives and wakes in the harbor tavern, burdened by survivor's guilt. He has no idea whether any of his comrades escaped alive.

sections.title: The Grim Remnant
sections.body: Longbraid the Grim still lives in the northern marshes near the captured fortress, keeping a battered handful of survivors together. The veteran commander is relieved to learn that Harlo survived his grievous wound. Yet Dun Modr remains firmly in Dark Iron hands. Cutthroats and saboteurs occupy its halls and threaten the corridor between Khaz Modan and the human lands to the north.

faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves overran Dun Modr after the garrison was ambushed at the nearby Thandol Span. They struck before its defenders could secure the town and wiped out most of the regiment.

Harlo Barnaby is an Ironforge soldier who was stationed at Dun Modr and barely survived its fall. A thrown axe struck his back during the retreat, so his commander strapped him to the garrison's sole surviving horse and sent him south to Menethil Harbor for medical care.

faq.q: Where is Longbraid the Grim located?
faq.answer: Commander Longbraid the Grim took refuge in the wilderness just outside occupied Dun Modr, near the northern highway toward the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why is Dun Modr strategically important?
faq.answer: Dun Modr is the Wetlands' northernmost settlement and fortification. It guards the southern approach to the Thandol Span, the only land bridge linking Khaz Modan with the Arathi Highlands and Lordaeron.

faq.q: Who are the attackers at Dun Modr?
faq.answer: The attackers are Dark Iron dwarves from the Dark Iron clan in the south. They have pushed north into the Wetlands to destroy infrastructure such as the Thandol Span and harass Ironforge's territory.

what comes after fall of dun modr
faq.answer: After you confirm Longbraid is alive and tell him Barnaby survived, Longbraid enlists you in a grim mission of vengeance against the Dark Iron forces occupying Dun Modr's ruins.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may feel the slaughter of Ironforge mountaineers and the desecration of Dun Modr by clan kin from the south as a bitter personal insult. Blood must answer blood.
As an Alliance member, you know Dun Modr's fall cuts safe overland travel between Ironforge and northern Alliance operations in the Arathi Highlands. The corridor now lies open to sabotage.
